description_en: Queries monitoring data for specified metrics, such as network bandwidth
description_zh: 查询指定监控项的监控数据，支持网络带宽等监控数据的查询
kebab_example: aliyun eds-aic describe-metric-list --metric-names bandwidth_package_usage_in --android-instance-ids cpn-25nt4kk9whhok0000 --instance-ids np-5hh4a31emkt6u0000 --process-infos '[{"ProcessName":"php-fpm","ProcessIds":[1]}]' --period 60 --start-time 2019-01-31_10:00:00 --end-time 2019-01-31_11:00:00 --next-token AAAAAV3MpHK1AP0pfERHZN5pu6kw9dGL5jves2FS9RLq0000 --length 1000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeMetricList

parameters.help_en:
For instance-level monitoring, enter a list of Cloud Phone instance IDs.

<props="china">

For matrix-level monitoring, enter a list of matrix IDs.

</props>
parameters.help_zh:
实例级别的监控，传入云手机实例ID列表。

<props="china">矩阵级别的监控，传入矩阵ID列表。</props>
parameters.name: android_instance_ids

parameters.help_en: A list of process monitoring metrics
parameters.name: process_infos

parameters.help_en:
The statistic period of the monitoring data.

Valid values: 60, 900, and 3600.

Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh:
监控数据的统计周期。

取值：60、900 和 3600。

单位：秒
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en: The start time for the query
parameters.help_zh: 查询监控项的开始时间
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time for the query
parameters.help_zh: 查询监控项的结束时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: A token that marks the position from which the query starts. Leave it empty to start from the beginning
parameters.help_zh: 用来标记当前开始读取的位置。置空表示从头开始
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page for a paged query.

Default value: 1000. This means that 1000 monitoring data records are returned per page
parameters.help_zh:
返回监控数据的每页大小，用于分页查询。

默认值：1000，即每页 1000 条监控数据
parameters.name: length
